race.comment: UPSTREAM (10) has been competitive since a win from a wide barrier at this circuit and distance last month and kept the ball rolling last time when fourth in a higher-graded race. She is a winning hope with even luck from the back row. BOUGANVILLEA (7) is building into her campaign and came from this barrier for third at this circuit and distance last week. Could be ready to peak. HEAVENLY REASON (9) didn't do a bad job from this row at Penrith last time out and had placed in three of her previous four outings. SAINT KARAMARA (4) drew wide and didn't have the best of luck last start but recorded back-to-back seconds at this circuit and distance prior.
